_comment: Routines a database platform provides that a repository calls but never
declares. A call matches only when no repository declaration answers it,
the calling file's dialect is listed, and its path shows the repository
targets that platform (path_pattern). The call is then an external
platform boundary named by 'provider', which the trace-boundary catalog
(trace_boundaries.json) classifies; anything else stays a gap.
'tables' lists the tables the platform provides; a read or write of one the repository does not declare is a platform boundary too, never a declared table.
